paragraphs: Sue Boursiani is a Registered Psychologist (ABN: 86 398 817 050) (PSY0001067955) consulting at the Earlwood and Sans Souci centres. She holds a Master of Education in Counselling Psychology, a Bachelor of Arts in Psychology, and a Diploma of Education.

Sue is a passionate psychologist with over 25 years’ experience working with young children, adolescents, and adults with a wide range of learning, behavioural and mental health issues. She provides psychological services that are inclusive, culturally aware, safe, and welcoming.

Sue has an extensive background in education & understand the psychological needs of school aged children. She has expertise in a number of standardised cognitive assessments, academic assessments, and emotional/behavioural assessments to assist with accurate diagnosis and understanding of a child's needs. Sue’s personal style is empathetic, and values driven. She draws from a range of evidence-based interventions to address individual needs, including: \- Cognitive Behavioural Therapy \- Acceptance and Commitment Therapy \- Schema Therapy \- Solution-Focused Brief Therapy \- Dialectical Behaviour Therapy

Sue has experience and interest working with a number of presentations including depression, anxiety (including OCD), post-traumatic stress, deliberate self-harm, emotional dysregulation, academic and work-related stress, and relationship difficulties. As a trained Child Consultant, Sue also brings meaningful and safe inclusion of the children’s voice to positively shape post-separation parenting. Sue believes in a collaborative and flexible approach, that focuses on building a strong therapeutic alliance and tailors treatment approaches to the specific needs of individuals.
